facts.seasonalNote: The official introduction describes an approximately 40-minute film and 10-minute seasonal star presentation. Check December titles, languages and sessions. The photo illustrates the theatre, not a guaranteed film.

astronomy-dome-stars.imageAlt: A nebula across the dome screen above reclined audience seats
astronomy-dome-stars.imageCredit: Taipei Astronomical Museum, supplied to Youth Daily (2024-12-25)

zhongzheng-archery.title: Try aiming a bow at Zhongzheng Sports Center
zhongzheng-archery.description: Take the safety briefing, put on protective equipment and practise drawing and releasing a bow towards a target. This is a focused beginner activity.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: First-time users receive a 10–15-minute briefing and equipment help. Standing and shoulder effort are required. Wear athletic shoes, confirm minor participation and bow fit, and follow arrow-retrieval instructions.
facts.seasonalNote: Bow rental includes basic instruction. Confirm available target distances, December opening, reservations and fees with the centre.

zhongzheng-archery.imageAlt: The indoor archery targets and marked shooting positions

wupo-perfume-making.title: Blend your own perfume at Wupo’s Tayou studio
wupo-perfume-making.description: Use scent strips to compare fragrance notes, then blend a perfume you like. This is a seated, careful activity with many aromas in the room.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The Tayou course lasts about 90 minutes. It involves seated fine hand work; check suitability if sensitive to scents. The studio is at 97-2 Tayou Road, Songshan.
facts.seasonalNote: Reserve and confirm December sessions, materials and fees; the current course listing does not guarantee a session on the trip dates.

wupo-perfume-making.imageAlt: Two participants using fragrance bottles and scent strips in the Tayou studio

cookinn-dumplings.title: Make soup dumplings and eat your cooking at Cookinn
cookinn-dumplings.description: Follow an instructor to make dough and fold soup dumplings, learn Taiwanese dishes, and share the lunch you make. Allow a morning for step-by-step kitchen work.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The official class is three hours including lunch. Expect food preparation, fine hand work and some kitchen standing. It includes wheat, milk and sesame allergens; confirm pork alternatives, vegetarian options and teaching language when booking.
facts.seasonalNote: The current class requires at least four and accepts up to twelve participants. Confirm December dates, the Taipei studio and dietary needs; insufficient bookings can require a date change.

cookinn-dumplings.imageAlt: Hands holding a soup-dumpling wrapper with its filling

tpoint-silver-ring.title: Make a silver ring with tools at T-Point Metalart
tpoint-silver-ring.description: Measure, hammer and refine silver at a workbench with an instructor to make a ring you can wear. This takes patience with hand tools.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The official general estimate is 3.5–4 hours. Hand strength and fine work are involved; follow instruction for tools and heating. The ring page recommends ages 12–65, so ask about participation or support for age 11 or 70 rather than hiding the choice.
facts.seasonalNote: Reserve and confirm December sessions, materials and fees; the current course listing does not guarantee a session on the trip dates. Extra stone-setting or plating can require later collection.

tpoint-silver-ring.imageAlt: Two participants using hand tools at metalworking benches

kuos-pineapple-diy.title: Make pineapple pastries at Kuo Yuan Ye in Shilin
kuos-pineapple-diy.description: Knead pastry, wrap pineapple filling, press it into moulds and package the baked results. Make your own version of a Taiwanese gift snack.
kuos-pineapple-diy.sourceTitle: Kuo Yuan Ye Shilin Museum — activity information

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The current sessions last about two hours, with kneading and fine hand work. Ages twelve and under use a parent-and-child shared-material option. Confirm ingredients, allergies and access between floors.
facts.seasonalNote: The official listing is for October 2026 in Shilin and verifies the process and rules. It does not confirm a December session or identical price; reserve once December sessions are published.

kuos-pineapple-diy.imageAlt: Dough ingredients and utensils arranged on the Shilin DIY worktable

holiday-karaoke.title: Take turns singing in a private karaoke room in Ximending
holiday-karaoke.description: Choose favourite songs on the room’s system and take turns with the microphones, listening or singing together. It is a group music session in a private room.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: You can sit or stand, but sound may be loud. Confirm screen controls, suitable room capacity and venue rules.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo is an example VIP room for 15–20 people, not a guaranteed allocation. Confirm room size, charged duration, food minimum and service charges when booking.

holiday-karaoke.imageAlt: The song screen, sofas and tables in Xining room 401

miramar-ferris-cabin.title: Watch the city rise beneath a Miramar Ferris wheel cabin
miramar-ferris-cabin.description: Sit in a cabin as the wheel slowly lifts the city into view, then watch buildings and roads below. Expect height and slight cabin movement.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The city’s official introduction gives about seventeen minutes per rotation; allow extra queue time. Consider enclosed cabins, height, movement and the actual health rules.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo is a 2021 cabin visit, with no promise of identical lighting or cabin allocation. Check December operation, weather closures, prices and cabin options.

miramar-ferris-cabin.imageAlt: Two passengers inside a Ferris wheel cabin with city lights beyond the windows

maokong-pothole-trail.title: Cross a small bridge on Maokong’s pothole trail
maokong-pothole-trail.description: Follow steps and wooded paths to a small suspension bridge, then view the creek valley and eroded rock features. Expect climbing and some bridge movement.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The route has stairs, slopes and a suspension bridge. Rain can make it slippery and winter wind can be cold. Allow extra travel from Maokong Station and back; stay out of the creek bed.
facts.seasonalNote: This is a creek route with stairs and a bridge, distinct from the existing Zhangshu Trail pond proposal. Change plans for rain or temporary closure.

maokong-pothole-trail.imageAlt: A small triangular suspension bridge above the wooded creek valley
maokong-pothole-trail.imageCredit: Taipei Metro / Maokong Gondola official website

water-museum-pumps.title: Inspect old pumps and pipes at the Water Museum
water-museum-pumps.description: Enter the historic pumping room to see large pipes and preserved machinery, and imagine how water reached the city. This is a museum stop for real industrial equipment.
water-museum-pumps.sourceTitle: Museum of Drinking Water — activity information

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Expect walking, standing and level changes; ask about suitable access if needed. This proposal covers museum equipment, not summer water-play pools.
facts.seasonalNote: Check Taipei Water Department announcements for December opening, entrances and prices. The historic machinery is for viewing; operation or hands-on use is not promised.

water-museum-pumps.imageAlt: Large black pumps and pipes inside the Water Museum’s pumping room
water-museum-pumps.imageCredit: Taiwan Tourism Administration / Museum of Drinking Water

yaoyue-tea-brewing.title: Brew small cups of tea yourself at Yaoyue in Maokong
yaoyue-tea-brewing.description: Choose tea at a hillside table, pour hot water into a small pot and share the brew in small cups. Compare successive infusions during a quiet hands-on tea session.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The teahouse and hillside seating have steps. Handle hot water and teapots carefully; ask about seating and assistance. Allow extra travel from central Taipei and walking or bus connections.
facts.seasonalNote: The tea equipment photo is from a 2013 visit; the official site currently still offers tea brewing. Equipment, seating and menu may differ. Confirm December tea-service charges, leaves and seating, including indoor alternatives for rain.

yaoyue-tea-brewing.imageAlt: Yaoyue’s teapot, tea tray and two freshly brewed cups

dihua-wheel-pottery.title: Shape wet clay on a pottery wheel in Dihua Street
dihua-wheel-pottery.description: Hold rotating clay with both hands, then raise and refine it into a cup or bowl. Expect wet clay and repeated attempts to control the shape.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The classroom is on the third floor of the rear historic building, reached by stairs. Expect sustained sitting and hand effort. Follow wheel instructions and wear clothes that can get clay on them.
facts.seasonalNote: Reserve and confirm December sessions, materials and fees; the current course listing does not guarantee a session on the trip dates. Confirm firing and shipping; a finished piece may not be ready during the trip.

dihua-wheel-pottery.imageAlt: A participant shaping wet clay on a wheel with an instructor beside them

dihua-handbuilt-pottery.title: Hand-build a clay cup in Dihua Street
dihua-handbuilt-pottery.description: Pinch, press and join clay by hand to form a cup or small vessel. Enjoy shaping it freely, including a result that may be uneven.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The rear historic classroom is on the third floor with stairs. The activity mainly involves seated fine hand work. Available forms depend on the booked course and instructor.
facts.seasonalNote: Reserve and confirm December sessions, materials and fees; the current course listing does not guarantee a session on the trip dates. Confirm firing, collection and shipping charges or waits; same-day collection is not guaranteed.

dihua-handbuilt-pottery.imageAlt: A participant shaping cup-like clay by hand at a table

dihua-ceramic-painting.title: Paint your own design on a ceramic dish in Dihua Street
dihua-ceramic-painting.description: Choose brushes and colours at a craft table, then paint lines, animals or a design you imagine onto a ceramic vessel. Make a drawing you can use in daily life.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The rear classroom is on the third floor with stairs. Expect seated fine hand work. Vessel shapes and colours depend on the booked course; the photographed design is not guaranteed.
facts.seasonalNote: Reserve and confirm December sessions, materials and fees; the current course listing does not guarantee a session on the trip dates. Confirm firing and collection or shipping for the finished vessel.

dihua-ceramic-painting.imageAlt: A participant painting ceramic ware with a fine brush at a table

xr-racing.title: Steer around a virtual track at Light XR
xr-racing.description: Sit in a racing seat with a headset and steer around a virtual track. Expect speed and turning visuals, with possible motion sickness.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Use the wheel while seated; consider headset fit, fast visuals and getting into the seat.
facts.seasonalNote: The current operator rules require a guardian below age twelve and exclude pregnancy, heart disease, high blood pressure and epilepsy. Confirm December opening, games and fees; ages 11–70 do not preselect interest.

xr-racing.imageAlt: The VR racing seat, steering wheel and equipment
xr-racing.imageCredit: Light in Generation / Light XR Park

xr-boxing.title: Throw punches in a headset boxing game at Light XR
xr-boxing.description: Wear a headset in front of a punching bag and follow the game with boxing movements. Expect rhythmic physical effort and controlled punches.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Requires standing, shoulder movement and repeated punches; follow staff instructions and assess participation individually.
facts.seasonalNote: The current operator rules require a guardian below age twelve and exclude pregnancy, heart disease, high blood pressure and epilepsy. Confirm December opening, games and fees; ages 11–70 do not preselect interest.

xr-boxing.imageAlt: A headset-wearing player punching towards the bag
xr-boxing.imageCredit: Light in Generation / Light XR Park

xr-space-walk.title: Move through a virtual space adventure at Light XR
xr-space-walk.description: Prepare in the lit tunnel, put on a headset and enter a virtual space scene with movement and game challenges. Expect fantasy action and flashes.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The headset obscures the real world; follow the designated movement area. Assess strong visuals, motion sickness and standing needs.
facts.seasonalNote: The current operator rules require a guardian below age twelve and exclude pregnancy, heart disease, high blood pressure and epilepsy. Confirm December opening, games and fees; ages 11–70 do not preselect interest.

xr-space-walk.imageAlt: The lit blue XR adventure tunnel and headset activity space
xr-space-walk.imageCredit: Light in Generation / Light XR Park

xr-cartoon-adventure.title: Control cartoon characters in mixed reality at Light XR
xr-cartoon-adventure.description: Wear a headset and use controllers to guide cartoon characters through a three-dimensional game scene around you. Try seeing virtual characters layered into the room.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Requires holding controllers and standing. The current official description allows one to four players for about 10–15 minutes; allow extra setup and queue time.
facts.seasonalNote: The current operator rules require a guardian below age twelve and exclude pregnancy, heart disease, high blood pressure and epilepsy. Confirm December opening, games and fees; ages 11–70 do not preselect interest.

xr-cartoon-adventure.imageAlt: Players wearing headsets and holding controllers in the Light XR play space
xr-cartoon-adventure.imageCredit: Light in Generation / Light XR Park

zoo-giraffes.title: Look up at giraffes at Taipei Zoo
zoo-giraffes.description: Watch giraffes stretch their necks, walk or browse in the African area, noticing the brown net-like coat pattern. They may rest far from the viewing point.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The zoo involves long walks, slopes and possible queues. This estimate covers the selected area only; allow extra time for entry and travel between areas.
facts.seasonalNote: Animals may rest, hide or be off display for care. Feeding, young animals and every individual shown in the photo are not guaranteed. The giraffe photo is a 2022 record, not a promise that the same young animal or individuals remain on display.

zoo-giraffes.imageAlt: An adult and young giraffe in Taipei Zoo’s outdoor exhibit

zoo-hippos.title: Watch hippos at Taipei Zoo
zoo-hippos.description: Wait beside the African area’s hippo exhibit for a closer view or a rise above the water, noticing broad mouths and heavy bodies. This takes patient observation.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The zoo involves long walks, slopes and possible queues. This estimate covers the selected area only; allow extra time for entry and travel between areas.
facts.seasonalNote: Animals may rest, hide or be off display for care. Feeding, young animals and every individual shown in the photo are not guaranteed.

zoo-hippos.imageAlt: An adult and young hippo beside grass in the exhibit

zoo-zebras.title: Study zebra stripes at Taipei Zoo
zoo-zebras.description: Find Chapman’s zebras in the African area and notice how the black and white stripes change direction across their bodies and legs.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The zoo involves long walks, slopes and possible queues. This estimate covers the selected area only; allow extra time for entry and travel between areas.
facts.seasonalNote: Animals may rest, hide or be off display for care. Feeding, young animals and every individual shown in the photo are not guaranteed.

zoo-zebras.imageAlt: A Chapman’s zebra in the grassy exhibit

zoo-lemurs.title: Look for lemurs and their long tails at Taipei Zoo
zoo-lemurs.description: Watch black-and-white ruffed lemurs in the African area, looking for their long tails, white neck fur and climbing movements.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The zoo involves long walks, slopes and possible queues. This estimate covers the selected area only; allow extra time for entry and travel between areas.
facts.seasonalNote: Animals may rest, hide or be off display for care. Feeding, young animals and every individual shown in the photo are not guaranteed.

zoo-lemurs.imageAlt: A black-and-white ruffed lemur with its long tail stretched across the grass

zoo-alligators.title: Inspect alligator eyes and scales at Taipei Zoo
zoo-alligators.description: Look through the exhibit glass at Chinese alligators’ eyes, long snouts and armoured scales. Expect a reptile that may remain still.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The zoo involves long walks, slopes and possible queues. This estimate covers the selected area only; allow extra time for entry and travel between areas.
facts.seasonalNote: Animals may rest, hide or be off display for care. Feeding, young animals and every individual shown in the photo are not guaranteed.

zoo-alligators.imageAlt: A Chinese alligator resting beside rocks in the reptile exhibit

guandu-scope-birdwatching.title: Find wild wetland birds through scopes at Guandu Nature Park
guandu-scope-birdwatching.description: Use the nature centre’s high-power scopes beside the viewing windows to find waterbirds swimming, feeding or preening. This is quiet observation of wild birds, with some waiting.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The second-floor scope area requires adjusting the viewing height. The park has ramps, a lift and wheelchair loan; confirm individual needs. Allow extra walking or transport after Guandu MRT Station.
facts.seasonalNote: The current Saturday and Sunday programme includes staffed scope interpretation; recheck December sessions. Winter suits migratory-bird watching, but species, numbers and visibility are not guaranteed.

guandu-scope-birdwatching.imageAlt: A visitor using a high-power birdwatching scope beside the nature centre windows

linantai-domestic-furniture.title: See old-style beds and domestic rooms at Lin An Tai House
linantai-domestic-furniture.description: Enter the open rooms of this traditional southern-Fujian house to see wooden beds, wardrobes and family living spaces, then follow its corridors. Explore how a historic home was used.
linantai-domestic-furniture.sourceTitle: Lin An Tai Historic House — activity information

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Expect thresholds, narrow corridors and level changes. Do not touch displays. MRT stations are about 1.4 km away; buses can stop closer. Allow extra travel.
facts.seasonalNote: The current rules give free entry and closure on Mondays and specified traditional holidays. Recheck December room access and temporary restrictions; no particular exhibition or guided tour is promised.

linantai-domestic-furniture.imageAlt: An old-style wooden bed, red wardrobe and washstand inside the historic house
linantai-domestic-furniture.imageCredit: Taipei Department of Civil Affairs / Lin An Tai Historic House

suho-hand-papermaking.title: Make a sheet of paper by hand at Suho Museum
suho-hand-papermaking.description: Stir paper pulp, lift the fibres with a wooden mesh frame and add plant decorations, then wait for your handmade sheet to dry. See paper form directly from water.
suho-hand-papermaking.sourceTitle: Suho Memorial Paper Museum — activity information

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The official workshop is about forty minutes plus fifteen minutes for drying and packing. It takes place on the fourth-floor papermaking balcony; ask about access. Expect standing, holding a frame and water contact, with cool water and wind possible in winter.
facts.seasonalNote: The current programme runs Tuesday through Saturday, with Sunday and Monday closed. Sessions have limited places and late entry is not allowed. Confirm December opening and availability; plant-decorated paper sessions can be reserved.

suho-hand-papermaking.imageAlt: An instructor helping visitors use wooden mesh frames at the papermaking vats
suho-hand-papermaking.imageCredit: Suho Memorial Paper Museum official website

cacacity-tabletop-session.title: Share a tabletop game at Cacacity in Gongguan
cacacity-tabletop-session.description: Choose a game together, learn the rules and take turns using cards or pieces while talking. This is a seated group activity that takes some patience to learn.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The fourth-floor shop is reached by a lift through Lane 283. Expect reading, hand movements and waiting for turns. Teaching is not included in the standard space fee; staff can help when available and familiar with the game.
facts.seasonalNote: The photo is a 2018 game session; the current official page still offers hosted play. The same game and instruction are not guaranteed. Confirm December opening, seats, language, beginner games and charges.

cacacity-tabletop-session.imageAlt: Players using a drawing-and-guessing boardgame at the Gongguan shop

missgame-prison-puzzle.title: Solve a short prison escape puzzle together in Ximending
missgame-prison-puzzle.description: Search a prison-themed set for clues, share ideas and solve a timed escape puzzle together. Expect enclosed scenery and some time pressure.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The game is about twenty minutes, or thirty with briefing; arrive ten minutes early. Standing, movement and clue reading are involved. The operator advises against participation below 110 cm or during pregnancy. Avoid heels and confirm language and access needs.
facts.seasonalNote: The current game takes two to six people; a non-private booking can include other players. The photo demonstrates the set, not a promise of actors in every session. Confirm December times, private booking and charges.

missgame-prison-puzzle.imageAlt: Bars and character demonstration inside the Prison Break set

beitou-billiards.title: Aim pool shots at Beitou Metro Resort
beitou-billiards.description: Take turns aiming the cue ball and trying to pocket balls. This is a slower, focused indoor game for two, with standing and bending.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Expect standing, bending and cue use. The official page allows one to two people per table with a one-hour minimum. Wear athletic shoes; a non-member rate is listed, but confirm registration and equipment supply.
facts.seasonalNote: The page was updated in April 2026. Confirm December table availability, guest registration and opening with the venue; current rates are not a trip-date promise.

beitou-billiards.imageAlt: Blue pool tables, overhead lights and broad aisles inside Beitou Metro Resort

spot-cinema-film.title: Watch a film in SPOT Taipei’s small cinema
spot-cinema-film.description: Choose a currently scheduled film suitable for the group and settle into the small cinema’s red seats for a complete screening. This gives a winter day a long seated movie break.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Expect prolonged sitting, darkness and auditorium steps. Runtime, subtitles and language depend on the film. Ask about accessible seats and routes if needed.
facts.seasonalNote: The official site currently lists October 2026 screenings, confirming ongoing operation. No current title is substituted for a December film. Choose a film together and check its rating, language, time and price before the visit.

spot-cinema-film.imageAlt: Red seats and the projection screen inside SPOT Taipei’s cinema
spot-cinema-film.imageCredit: SPOT Taipei / Taiwan Film and Culture Association

taipeieye-taiwanese-opera.title: Watch costumed Taiwanese opera live at TaipeiEYE
taipeieye-taiwanese-opera.description: See performers in colourful costumes, listen to their singing and follow gestures and the story with subtitles. Spend an evening at a live traditional performance.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Mainly seated, with theatre access and steps to consider. Sound can be loud and subtitles require reading. Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean subtitles are provided; ask about suitable seating or assistance.
facts.seasonalNote: As of 8 October 2026, the official programme publishes The Mermaid’s Tale on Wed/Fri/Sat at 20:00 from 9–26 December, giving trip-date options on 23, 25 or 26 December. This is a published programme; still confirm ticket availability and changes. The source stage photograph is from a 2023 production; the 2026 cast and costumes may differ.

taipeieye-taiwanese-opera.imageAlt: Costumed performers across the blue stage in The Mermaid’s Tale

taipeieye-handle-props.title: Handle traditional opera props before the show at TaipeiEYE
taipeieye-handle-props.description: Under staff guidance, try holding a horse whip, fan or stage weapon and feel its weight and shape. Make contact with objects used in traditional performance.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: This is a pre-show cultural experience after theatre admission, arranged with the performance visit. Expect standing and holding props; follow instructions and avoid swinging towards others.
facts.seasonalNote: The official activity page invites hands-on prop use before performances. It is not a separate all-day attraction. Confirm December availability, arrival time and ticket inclusions; not every displayed prop is guaranteed.

taipeieye-handle-props.imageAlt: Whips, stage weapons and other opera props in the cultural experience area

blue-note-live-jazz.title: Listen to live jazz close to the musicians at Blue Note Taipei
blue-note-live-jazz.description: Sit at a table in the small music room and listen to piano, bass or wind instruments respond to each other. Enjoy live sound, with a late-evening start to consider.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: The operator welcomes ages seven and above and provides non-alcoholic drinks below eighteen. The venue is on the fourth floor at 171 Roosevelt Road Section 3; ask about access. Consider sightlines, sound level and late show times.
facts.seasonalNote: The operator currently lists October and some November 2026 shows, often starting at 21:00 or 21:30. No December band, price or nightly show is promised. Reserve after the December programme is published; the photo illustrates the live atmosphere.

blue-note-live-jazz.imageAlt: Musicians on Blue Note’s small stage with seated listeners nearby

toms-arcade-motorcycle.title: Ride a motorcycle arcade game in Ximending
toms-arcade-motorcycle.description: Sit on a motorcycle-shaped arcade machine, hold the controls and turn through an on-screen track for a short race. Try physical controls without a headset.

facts.cost: Confirm the current price with the venue or official announcements.
facts.mobility: Requires mounting the seat, holding controls and using tokens. Sound and lights can be intense. Check the machine’s fit and price per play; installed machines can change.
facts.seasonalNote: The operator currently lists the shop at 70 Xining South Road, fifth floor, with this on-site cabinet photo. The same machines may not be available in December. Check tokens, games, maintenance and opening with this branch.

toms-arcade-motorcycle.imageAlt: Red motorcycle-style racing cabinets and screens at Jinwannian
